001package org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.playwright;
002
003import java.nio.file.Path;
004import java.util.Objects;
005
006/**
007 * How {@link Browsing} runs a browser and takes screenshots.
008 *
009 * @param channel A browser installed on the machine, such as {@code chrome} or {@code msedge}.
010 * Null for the Chromium that Playwright downloads on first use
011 * @param headless Without a window
012 * @param width Viewport width in CSS pixels
013 * @param height Viewport height in CSS pixels
014 * @param screenshots Directory screenshots are written to, created if it does not exist
015 * @param stepScreenshots Screenshots a step takes by itself
016 * @param fullPage Screenshots of the full scrollable page rather than the viewport
017 */
018public record Options(
019                String channel,
020                boolean headless,
021                int width,
022                int height,
023                Path screenshots,
024                StepScreenshots stepScreenshots,
025                boolean fullPage) {
026
027        /**
028         * Screenshots a {@link Session#step(String, Session.StepBody) step} takes by itself. A failing
029         * step takes a screenshot of the failure in any case.
030         */
031        public enum StepScreenshots {
032
033                NONE,
034
035                AFTER,
036
037                /**
038                 * Before and after, as the Nasdanika WebTest did. No "before" of a blank page.
039                 */
040                BEFORE_AND_AFTER
041
042        }
043
044        public static final Options DEFAULT = new Options(null, true, 1280, 800, Path.of("target", "screenshots"), StepScreenshots.BEFORE_AND_AFTER, false);
045
046        public Options {
047                Objects.requireNonNull(screenshots, "screenshots");
048                Objects.requireNonNull(stepScreenshots, "stepScreenshots");
049                if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
050                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Viewport must not be empty: " + width + "x" + height);
051                }
052        }
053
054        public Options withChannel(String channel) {
055                return new Options(channel, headless, width, height, screenshots, stepScreenshots, fullPage);
056        }
057
058        public Options withHeadless(boolean headless) {
059                return new Options(channel, headless, width, height, screenshots, stepScreenshots, fullPage);
060        }
061
062        public Options withViewport(int width, int height) {
063                return new Options(channel, headless, width, height, screenshots, stepScreenshots, fullPage);
064        }
065
066        public Options withScreenshots(Path screenshots) {
067                return new Options(channel, headless, width, height, screenshots, stepScreenshots, fullPage);
068        }
069
070        public Options withStepScreenshots(StepScreenshots stepScreenshots) {
071                return new Options(channel, headless, width, height, screenshots, stepScreenshots, fullPage);
072        }
073
074        public Options withFullPage(boolean fullPage) {
075                return new Options(channel, headless, width, height, screenshots, stepScreenshots, fullPage);
076        }
077
078}
